summary: Amazon.com, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an offering of multiple series of senior unsecured notes denominated in Canadian dollars. The notes are being issued under an existing shelf registration statement. Specific terms such as principal amounts, interest rates, maturities, and redemption prices are left blank as the prospectus is subject to completion. No special situation event is present; this is a routine debt capital markets transaction.
